findings.title: Decoupling cap too far from U1
findings.description: Nearest decoupling cap to U1 (MCP6002-xSN) is 9.3mm away. Each mm of trace adds 0.3-0.8 nH of loop inductance, reducing decoupling effectiveness at high frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Move decoupling cap within 2-3mm of U1 power pins.
findings.summary: Decoupling cap too far from U1

findings.title: Decoupling cap moderately far from IC1
findings.description: Nearest decoupling cap to IC1 (TL072) is 5.1mm away. Recommended: <3mm for best high-frequency performance.
findings.recommendation: Move decoupling cap closer to IC1 power pins if layout permits.
findings.summary: Decoupling cap moderately far from IC1

findings.title: Decoupling cap moderately far from IC2
findings.description: Nearest decoupling cap to IC2 (TL072) is 5.0mm away. Recommended: <3mm for best high-frequency performance.
findings.recommendation: Move decoupling cap closer to IC2 power pins if layout permits.
findings.summary: Decoupling cap moderately far from IC2

findings.title: No decoupling cap found near U2
findings.description: U2 (MCP6002-xSN) has no capacitor within 10mm. Every IC with power pins needs at least one decoupling capacitor.
findings.recommendation: Add 100nF X7R 0402 + 1µF X5R 0603 close to U2 power pins. For high-speed ICs, add 10nF C0G for high-frequency decoupling. Place caps on the same side as U2 with short, wide traces to vias.
findings.summary: No decoupling cap found near U2

findings.title: Decoupling cap C11 far from via
findings.description: C11 is 4.1mm from the nearest via (~2.9nH connection inductance). Long traces between cap and via degrade high-frequency decoupling effectiveness.
findings.recommendation: Place a via directly adjacent to C11 pads. Use fat, short traces from cap pads to via.
findings.summary: Decoupling cap C11 far from via

findings.title: Decoupling cap C5 far from via
findings.description: C5 is 3.1mm from the nearest via (~2.2nH connection inductance). Long traces between cap and via degrade high-frequency decoupling effectiveness.
findings.recommendation: Place a via directly adjacent to C5 pads. Use fat, short traces from cap pads to via.

findings.title: No EMC filtering near J14
findings.description: Connector J14 (RIGHT Pin ROW DAISY) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near J14. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.
findings.summary: No EMC filtering near J14

findings.title: Signal layer F.Cu far from reference plane

findings.recommendation: Consider stackup adjustment to reduce signal-to-reference spacing.

findings.title: Board cavity resonance frequencies
findings.description: Board (100×100mm, εr=4.5) cavity resonances: (0,1) at 707 MHz; (1,0) at 707 MHz; (1,1) at 999 MHz; (0,2) at 1413 MHz; (2,0) at 1413 MHz. PDN impedance spikes at these frequencies. Ensure adequate decoupling at and around these frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Add decoupling capacitors with SRF near these frequencies.
findings.summary: Board cavity resonance frequencies
